en: Latest stable npm line (`@onekeyfe/hd-core@1.2.1`)
Harden Protocol V2 BLE firmware-install completion after reboot
Same public API as 1.2.0: V1/V2 auto-detect, openWalletSession, getDeviceState, firmwareUpdateV4
zh: 当前 npm 稳定线（`@onekeyfe/hd-core@1.2.1`）
加固 Protocol V2 BLE 固件安装在重启后的完成判定
公开 API 与 1.2.0 相同：V1/V2 自动识别、openWalletSession、getDeviceState、firmwareUpdateV4

en: Stable Protocol V2 line for OneKey Pro 2 and Neo; Classic / Mini / Touch / Pro stay on Protocol V1
Public wallet entry openWalletSession({ mode }) for standard, select-hidden, and resume-hidden
Unified getDeviceState() snapshot across V1/V2; getFeatures() remains compatibility
firmwareUpdateV4 for Pro 2 / Neo multi-component firmware and resource ZIP updates
BLE reconnect, wallet-session recovery, and firmware-install polling hardened for Protocol V2
zh: 稳定的 Protocol V2 线：OneKey Pro 2 / Neo；Classic / Mini / Touch / Pro 继续走 Protocol V1
公开开钱包入口 openWalletSession({ mode })：standard / select-hidden / resume-hidden
V1/V2 统一 getDeviceState()；getFeatures() 仍作兼容
Pro 2 / Neo 使用 firmwareUpdateV4 做多组件固件和资源 ZIP 升级
Protocol V2 的 BLE 重连、钱包会话恢复和固件安装轮询加固

en: Fixed iOS and extension firmware exchange issues

zh: 修复 iOS 和扩展程序的固件交换问题
